summary.text: Shay Micco is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election. A nurse, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is a mother of five from Lawrence County.

paragraphs.text: Shay Micco graduated from Wilmington Area High School.
She said her background includes nursing, healthcare leadership and studies in cultural anthropology.
Micco named economic opportunity for working families, investment in infrastructure, public education, healthcare and affordable housing among her key messages.
